verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YE Kigambo wa Katonda,
Kristo Yesu-Omwana we,
Ye n'afuuka omubiri
N'abeerako gye tuli
Ne tulaba omusana
-Okumulisa-enzikisa

verse.name: v3
v5
verse.lines:
Bwe baalagira banabbi
-Ab'amagezi-edda n'edda,
Mu kitabo-ekyawandiikibwa
Esuubi lye ettukuvu,
Eyazaalibwa-okubeera
Omununuzi waffe;

verse.name: v7
v9
v11
verse.lines:
Mwebaze mmwe-eby'omu ggulu
-Awamu n'ebyensi zonna,
Mmwe muyimbe abalonde
N'aboonoonyi muddemu
Buli olulimi lwonna,
Lwebaze ettendo lye ;

verse.name: v13
verse.lines:
Oluyimba olukulu!
Abakadde n'abato,
Abalenzi n'abawala
Banaayatula Yesu,
Era banaatendereza;
Ye Mulokozi waabwe,
